title: Giants outmatched in 28-6 loss to Rams after Jaxson Dart goes down early

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants outmatched in 28-6 loss to Rams after Jaxson Dart goes down early
sources.description: The Los Angeles Rams capitalized on Giants QB Jaxson Dart’s absence as Matthew Stafford paced them with four touchdown passes in a 28-6 blowout win.
